ozet: A mountain north-east of Mecca. Every year in the month of Ramadan, the Prophet withdrew to the cave here to worship alone.
A valley south-east of Mecca, between Ta'if and Nakhla. Every year in the month of Dhu al-Qa'da the greatest fair of the Arabs was held here.

A market town south of Damascus; the caravans of Quraysh often stopped here. The Prophet halted here on the journey he made with his uncle Abu Talib at the age of twelve. According to a report, on the journey he made with Khadija's caravan at the age of twenty-five, a monk also spoke about him.
